blocks.text: Computational biology ek interdisciplinary (kai mazameen ko jodne wala) shoba hai jo biology ke masail hal karne ke liye computer ki techniques aur tools istemal karta hai. Is mein biology, computer science, mathematics aur statistics ka ilm mila kar biological data ko parha aur samjha jata hai. Is ki ahmiyat yeh hai ke yeh bohat bade datasets sambhal sakti hai, chhupe hue patterns dhoond sakti hai, aur aise predictive models (aage ka andaza lagane wale models) bana sakti hai jin se biology mein nayi samajh aur naye faide milte hain. Computational biology ke bade hisse (areas) yeh hain:

items: Genomics: genomes ka mutala (study). Genome kisi jandar (organism) ke ek cell ke andar maujood poora DNA hai. Genomics mein genomes ki sequencing (tarteeb parhna), assembling (tukde jodna) aur un ki structure aur kaam ka tajziya (analysis) hota hai. Is se genetic variations (genes ke farq), gene ka kaam aur evolutionary relationships (irtiqai rishte) samajh aate hain.

Proteomics: proteins ka bade paimane par mutala, un ki structure aur kaam samet. Proteins zaroori molecules hain jo jandar mein bohat se kaam karte hain. Proteomics ka maqsad hai ke kisi jandar ke banaye hue tamam proteins (proteome) ka naqsha banaya jaye aur samjha jaye ke cell ke kaamon mein yeh aapas mein kaise milte aur kya kirdar ada karte hain.

Bioinformatics: biological data ko sambhalne aur parhne ke liye computer technology ka istemal. Bioinformatics ke tools DNA, RNA aur protein sequences ko store karne, wapas nikalne (retrieve) aur analyze karne mein kaam aate hain.

blocks.text: Computational biology ke bohat se faide hain; kuch yeh hain.

items: Drug discovery (nayi dawa dhoondna): computational biology mumkina drug targets pehchanne aur computer par dawaon ka asar simulate karne (naqal kar ke dekhne) mein madad deti hai. Yeh andaza laga kar ke dawa proteins aur doosre molecules se kaise milegi, nayi dawa dhoondne ka kaam tez kar deti hai.

Genetic research: DNA sequences parh kar computational biology woh genetic variations pehchanti hai jo beemariyon se jude hain. Is se beemari ki genetic wajah samajh aati hai aur personalized medicine (har mareez ke liye us ke genes ke mutabiq dawa) ban sakti hai.

Evolutionary biology: computer tools se mukhtalif species ki genetic maloomat ka muqabla kiya jata hai. Is se evolutionary rishte dobara jode ja sakte hain aur evolution (irtiqa) ka amal samajh aata hai.

blocks.text: Key databases (aham databases): nucleic acids aur proteins parhne ke liye kuch aham databases yeh hain.

GenBank: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/nuccore/ Yeh nucleotide sequences ka ek bada public (sab ke liye khula) database hai jis mein un ke saath bibliographic (kis research mein chhapa) aur biological annotations (notes) bhi hain. Is mein bohat se jandaron ke DNA sequences ka bada zakheera hai, jo genetic research aur comparative genomics (genomes ka muqabla) mein madad karta hai.

Yeh database proteins aur nucleic acids jaise bade biological molecules ka 3D structure data deta hai. Yeh macromolecules ki structure parhne, un ka kaam samajhne, aur aisi dawaein design karne ke liye aham hai jo khaas protein structures ko nishana banayen.

Yeh ek genome browser hai jo mukhtalif species ke genome sequences, gene models aur comparative genomics ki maloomat deta hai. Ensembl se genomic data dekha aur samjha ja sakta hai, jo genomics aur evolutionary biology ki research mein kaam aata hai.
Upar ke databases ke ilawa data parhne ke liye kuch algorithms (computer ke tareeqe) bhi istemal hote hain:

BLAST (Basic Local Alignment Search Tool): yeh biological sequences ka muqabla karta hai, jaise proteins ke amino acid sequences ya DNA ke nucleotides. Is se homologous (ek hi asal se aaye) sequences milte hain, anjaan genes ke kaam ka andaza lagta hai aur evolutionary rishte parhe jate hain.

FASTA: yeh sequence alignment tool hai jo ek query sequence (jis ke baare mein poochna hai) ko database ke sequences se mila kar milte julte hisse dhoondta hai. Yeh protein aur nucleotide databases mein talash, sequence homology pehchanne aur sequence alignments parhne ke kaam aata hai.

blocks.prompt: Aap ke paas ek anjaan protein ka amino acid sequence hai. Us ki structure aur kaam ka andaza lagane ke liye kaun sa tool aur kaun se databases istemal karenge, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Sequence ko BLAST ya FASTA se database ke sequences ke saath milayen taake aise homologous sequences milen jin ka kaam pehle se maloom hai; homologous proteins aksar ek jaisa kaam karte hain. Phir Protein Data Bank (PDB) mein kisi qareebi homologous protein ki 3D structure dhoonden; us se anjaan protein ki structure aur active site ka andaza lagaya ja sakta hai.

items: Computational biology biology, computer science, mathematics aur statistics jod kar bade data ko parhti hai. Hisse: genomics (genome), proteomics (proteome), bioinformatics (sequence data).
Faide: drug discovery, genetic research aur personalized medicine, evolutionary biology.
Databases: GenBank (nucleotide sequences), Protein Data Bank (3D structures), Ensembl (genome browser). Algorithms: BLAST aur FASTA (sequences ka muqabla aur homology).
